metric: differential instructions I(n2)-I(n1), qemu-user + TCG insn plugin
description: wasi-sdk 25 / 30 / 34 (clang 19.1.5 / 21.1.4 / 23.1.0), each against a native control built with the official LLVM release of the same version, all run on wasmtime 50.0.0 (recommended config). The -mvp rows compile the benchmark code with -mcpu=mvp (the prebuilt libc keeps its features). sdk25-wt26 is the 2x2 corner: wasi-sdk 25 modules on wasmtime 26.0.1.
ratioMeaning: numerator differential / denominator differential (lower is better)
